Next year's iPhone Pro models are expected to feature a brand-new all-glass design to mark the 20th anniversary of the iPhone. A new leak today detailed Apple's progress on this innovative model.

Here's the latest on Apple's unique iPhone 20 Pro design

Apple's first foldable model — the innovative iPhone Ultra — is just weeks away from launch. But next year will bring another unique new iPhone design.

Rumors suggest Apple is preparing a special all-glass design for next year's iPhone Pro models. The new phone is reportedly set to feature a larger display with a quad-curved screen, where the glass extends to the edges of the body, creating a visually borderless effect.

Weibo leaker Fixed Focus Digital posted today, revealing Apple's progress in achieving this unique look.

He said Apple is using the same glass assembly process as the iPhone Air, but is making adjustments to adopt more rounded materials.

The post also mentioned improvements in two areas:

  • Thermal performance
  • Body thickness

It remains difficult to determine the thickness specifications and design materials Apple is pursuing. But so far, signs indicate that this new model will draw on design elements from the iPhone Air and Ultra, without making thinness its top priority.

Based on these latest reports, the new model is expected to blend the design innovations of the iPhone Air and Ultra, while meeting — or even approaching — the performance expectations of Pro users.

Pro users don't want the manufacturer to sacrifice performance for a thinner body. However, if Apple can deliver the same user experience in a slightly thinner body, paired with a unique all-glass look, it would surely be extremely appealing.

How interested are you in next year's rumored iPhone Pro 20 model? Let us know in the comments.
